title: Sudden death of entanglement, rebirth of magic
summary: Local Markovian noise cannot bring entanglement back, but it can bring magic back. Unlike separability, stabilizer membership is not preserved by local channels, allowing dissipation to push states out of the stabilizer polytope as well as in. Under local amplitude damping, the $n$-qubit GHZ family $α|0^n\rangle+β|1^n\rangle$ ($0 T_1$, unital dynamics produce no rebirth, and sufficiently weak thermal excitation confines rebirth to a finite magic island ending in a second sudden death.
